subject: Procurement readiness and MPA check-in - AcmeCloud
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Wang <emily.wang@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@acmecloud.com>, rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-08T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement readiness and MPA check-in - AcmeCloud

Hi Emily - thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on procurement and the mutual action plan (MAP):

Recap from today
- Decision-makers: Emily (Cloud Platform), Rajiv (Finance) confirmed as primary approvers.
- Technical gate: Security questionnaire + SOC 2 evidence requested by AcmeCloud security team.
- Preferred commercial path: Procurement team evaluating PO (net-30/60) vs. corporate card for pilot. Marketplace option (AWS Marketplace) is of interest for longer-term procurement.

Proposed commercial options for pilot
1) Card (fastest): Start immediately once payment details provided - ideal for a 30-60 day pilot.
2) Purchase Order (PO): Standard for enterprise; finance needs an itemized quote + SOW. PO timeline depends on legal/finance cadence.
3) Marketplace: Would prefer this for long-term procurement; adds lead time for listing and billing alignment.

Suggested timeline & milestones (draft MAP)
- Week 0 (this week): Share Redwood MPA (attached) + SOW draft; confirm preferred commercial path. (Owner: Marissa)
- Week 1: Security questionnaire returned to AcmeCloud security; provide SOC 2 report & architecture diagram. (Owner: AcmeCloud security / Redwood to provide artifacts)
- Week 2: Legal review (both sides) + contract redlines; if PO chosen, finance to prepare PO template. (Owner: Legal teams)
- Week 3: PO issuance or payment via card; onboarding kickoff. (Owner: AcmeCloud procurement + Redwood CS)

Action items
- Emily: confirm which commercial path you prefer for the pilot (card vs PO vs marketplace).
- Rajiv: let us know finance PO timeline / any vendor setup forms we should pre-fill.
- Emily/Rajiv: confirm if we should route SOC 2 and evidence to a security mailbox - happy to share via secure link.

Attachments: Redwood_MPA_v1.pdf, SOW-draft.docx (attached)

I can put the MAP into a shared doc and do a 15-min procurement sync next week if that helps accelerate.

Thanks - Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198
[Attachment: Redwood_MPA_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: SOW-draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Emily Wang <emily.wang@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@acmecloud.com>, procurement@acmecloud.com
Date: 2026-04-09T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement readiness and MPA check-in - AcmeCloud

Thanks Marissa - good summary. A few quick notes from our side:

- We like the three-path approach. For the pilot, Finance prefers card because it avoids the PO lead time. That said, Procurement wants the PO flow documented in case we expand.
- Security: please send SOC 2 and the architecture diagram to security-eval@acmecloud.com. We'll run the questionnaire in parallel.
- Timeline: card for the pilot would allow us to start within 3-5 business days once payment is set up. If we go PO, expect ~3 weeks for vendor setup + approvals.

We'll do the following:
- Rajiv will follow up with vendor setup form + a point of contact in Finance.
- Procurement (procurement@acmecloud.com) will review the MPA and flag any legal concerns.

Can you send the itemized quote and a short two-paragraph SOW summary (bullet points) for Finance to attach to the card/PO record?

Emily
Emily Wang
Head of Cloud Platform, AcmeCloud
emily.wang@acmecloud.com | (212) 555-0432

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@acmecloud.com>, procurement@acmecloud.com
Cc: rachel.kim@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-09T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement readiness and MPA check-in - AcmeCloud

Thanks Emily - adding Rajiv and procurement alias to iterate on the PO path while we keep card as the fast option.

Rajiv / procurement team - attaching a one-page itemized quote and a short SOW summary below to use for vendor setup and the finance record. Let me know if you need any additional vendor data (W9, vendor address, tax ID).

SOW summary (2 bullets for Finance)
- Pilot scope: 4 dedicated inference slots for 30 days for evaluation of latency and cost metrics; includes integration support and 2 training sessions for infra + SRE teams.
- Deliverables: access to Redwood dedicated pilot environment, onboarding runbook, and a 2-week optimization review.

Itemized quote (USD)
- Service fee (pilot, 30 days): $12,000
- Onboarding & integration: $3,000
- Optional extended support: $1,500
- Total: $16,500

Attachments included: itemized-quote.pdf (generated)

Proposed MAP update (owners & tentative dates)
- 2026-04-09: Provide itemized quote & send SOC2 + architecture diagram to security-eval@acmecloud.com (Owner: Marissa)
- 2026-04-12: Finance to confirm card setup OR indicate PO lead time and vendor form requirements (Owner: Rajiv)
- 2026-04-16: Legal redlines if PO chosen (Owner: AcmeCloud legal / Redwood legal)
- 2026-04-20: PO issuance or payment confirmation + pilot kickoff (Owner: Procurement + Redwood CS)

Let me know if those dates map to your internal calendar and I'll update the shared MAP doc and HubSpot milestones.

-Marissa

[Attachment: itemized-quote.pdf (application/pdf)]

If Finance needs a vendor contact, use: Redwood Inc. / marissa.cole@redwood.ai / 415-555-0198.
